title: 2022 EEO-1 Component 1 instruction and upload-specification references
useful_reference_domains: electronic data-file schema and upload formatting
authority_rule: These PDFs are federal reporting instructions/specifications, not RTEC policies.
Use them to interpret the corresponding 2022 EEO-1 reporting cycle or historical data files only.
Do not assume their deadlines, schemas, categories or technical upload requirements remain current for a later filing year without a current external-source check.
privacy_boundary: The external specifications themselves are public/reference material.
Any RTEC source rows used to build an EEO-1 report remain restricted if they contain employee identities or demographic attributes.
Generalized knowledge may store approved aggregate report outputs and schema definitions.
